Direct evidence matching all requirements is limited. [TensorFlow Recommenders](https://www.tensorflow.org/recommenders/examples/featurization) provides a reproducible scratch baseline: concatenate learned item-identity and title representations; title vocabulary capped at 10,000, 32-dimensional token embeddings, padding-masked mean pooling. No explicit text truncation or text-specific regularization is configured. [Keras’s newer example](https://keras.io/keras_rs/examples/deep_recommender/) specifies 10,000 tokens and 16-token titles. These are retrieval examples, not controlled sequential-recommendation studies. Sequential [FDSA](https://www.ijcai.org/proceedings/2019/0600.pdf) instead extracts five topical keywords from title/description, applies Word2vec, and mean-pools them; this is not jointly trained scratch token encoding.

For an order-sensitive scratch reference, [Kim’s CNN-rand](https://aclanthology.org/D14-1181.pdf) learns randomly initialized word embeddings with width-3/4/5 convolutions, 100 filters each, max pooling, dropout 0.5, and weight-norm constraint 3. Its controlled initialization comparisons favor pretrained vectors, but concern classification, not recommendation. [Deep Averaging Networks](https://aclanthology.org/P15-1162.pdf) report word dropout and competitive unordered composition, while acknowledging double-negation errors; their results rely on pretrained embeddings. None establishes superiority for product model numbers or compatibility. Mechanistically, raw embedding means discard order; contextual encoders followed by mean pooling can retain it. Exact model-number distinctions additionally depend on tokenization and vocabulary coverage.

Proposed lexical experiment, not a reported result: retain HSTU and jointly learn ID plus masked-mean title/description embeddings from scratch. Preserve alphanumeric model strings and negators; start with a 10,000-token vocabulary and separate title/description limits. Compare ID-only, title-only addition, title-plus-description, shuffled item-text assignments, and a parameter-matched local CNN. Measure OOV/truncation rates and validation HR@10; audit negation/compatibility examples separately. Keep seeds, objective, temporal features, and evaluation fixed; select one model per category.
